title: Containerising and Modernising an AI-Powered SaaS Platform on Kubernetes
summary: We helped an AI-powered SaaS provider modernise its application platform by containerising workloads, implementing CI/CD automation, and migrating to a secure multi-cluster Kubernetes environment. The project reduced operational overhead, improved deployment reliability, lowered infrastructure costs, and accelerated product delivery.
problem:
The client’s AI-powered SaaS platform was running on virtual machines, creating significant operational overhead and high infrastructure costs due to inefficient use of compute resources.

Deployments were time consuming, inconsistent across environments, and considered high risk due to the potential for service interruption. The lack of automation and standardised tooling limited deployment frequency and slowed the delivery of new features.

At the same time, the business was onboarding new customers and needed a more scalable, reliable, and efficient platform to support continued growth.
solution:
We modernised the existing platform by containerising applications and services and migrating workloads to a secure multi-cluster managed Kubernetes environment.

We designed cloud landing zones aligned to Microsoft’s Cloud Adoption Framework, creating a scalable and production-ready platform foundation capable of supporting future growth.

To improve engineering efficiency and deployment reliability, we implemented CI/CD automation, integrated cloud-native services, and standardised tooling, configuration management, and secrets storage across environments.

We also accelerated development workflows by creating reusable infrastructure and application components, enabling self-service workflows and establishing clear golden paths to production.
outcome:
The client significantly reduced the time spent managing infrastructure and increased focus on product development and feature delivery.

Deployment processes became faster, safer, and more predictable through automation and standardisation, allowing smaller changes to be deployed more frequently with lower operational risk.

The modernised platform improved infrastructure efficiency, reduced cloud costs, and provided a scalable foundation capable of supporting continued customer growth and future platform evolution.
